blocks.text: Kaha jata hai ke electric current charge ka bahao hai. Conductor mein charge uthane wale (charge carriers) azaad electrons hain. Jab conductor ke sire battery ya kisi aur source se jore jayein to conductor ke andar har nuqte par electric field qaim hoti hai. Azaad electrons par -E ki simt mein force lagti hai aur woh chalne lagte hain. Chunke woh atoms se takrate rehte hain, is force se seedhi lakeer mein tez nahi hote; conductor ke atoms se musalsal takrate hain. In takraon ka majmooi asar tez kiye gaye electrons ki energy lattice ko dena hai, aur nateeje mein electrons -E ki simt mein ek ausat velocity hasil karte hain jise drift velocity kehte hain. Drift velocity 10^-3 m s^-1 ke darje ki hai, aur electrons ka yeh drift electric current banata hai.

Dheemi drift velocity ka matlab yeh nahi ke current qaim hone mein der lagti hai; jaise hi bulb ka switch on karte hain woh fauran jal uthta hai. Switch on karne par circuit ke tamam azaad electrons ek saath drift karne lagte hain: woh padosi electrons ko dhakelte hain aur khalal taar ke saath taqreeban fauran phail jata hai. Isi liye current bohat tezi se qaim hota hai.

blocks.title: Electric current
blocks.text: Agar waqt t mein conductor ke kisi cross-section se khalis charge Q guzre to us mein current I = Q/t ... (9.28) hai. Current ki SI unit ampere (A) hai: fi second ek coulomb charge ke bahao se current.

Agar charges circuit mein hamesha ek hi simt mein chalein to current direct current (D.C.) hai; batteries direct current deti hain. Agar charges pehle ek taraf phir ulti taraf chalein, baqaida waqfon se simt badalte hue, to current alternating current (A.C.) hai; zyada tar electric generators A.C. banate hain, aur power stations se gharon, daftaron aur karkhanon ko di jane wali bijli A.C. hai.

Dhaati taaron mein electric current electrons ke bahao se hai, magar ibtidai scientists samajhte the ke yeh musbat charges ke bahao se hai. Scientists ne yeh riwayat (convention) qaim rakhi hai aur current ki simt woh lete hain jis mein musbat charges chalte; ise conventional current kehte hain.

blocks.title: Conventional current
blocks.text: Conventional current musbat charges ka woh farzi (hypothetical) bahao hai jo circuit mein wahi asar kare jo asal mein hone wala manfi charges ka bahao karta hai.

Fig. 9.20 mein manfi electrons battery ke musbat terminal par pohanchte hain; wahi asar tab hota agar utna hi musbat charge musbat terminal se nikalta. Lihaza conventional current bairooni circuit mein musbat terminal se manfi terminal ki taraf behta hai. Conventional current electric field aur potential ki tareef mein musbat test charge ke hamare pehle istemal se mel khata hai: is ki simt hamesha zyada potential wale nuqte se kam potential wale nuqte ki taraf hai. Ab se current I ka matlab hamesha conventional current hai.

blocks.prompt: Agar drift velocity sirf taqreeban 10^-3 m s^-1 hai to switch on karte hi bulb kyun jal uthta hai?
blocks.explanation: Taar pehle hi azaad electrons se bhara hai. Switch band karne se poore circuit mein electric field taqreeban fauran qaim ho jati hai, to bulb ke filament samet tamam azaad electrons ek saath drift karne lagte hain; kisi electron ko switch se bulb tak safar nahi karna parta.

items: Azaad electrons E ke khilaf taqreeban 10^-3 m s^-1 ki drift velocity se chalte aur lattice se takrate hain; field fauran phailti hai, to current fauran shuru hota hai. I = Q/t (9.28); 1 A = 1 C s^-1. D.C. ek taraf (batteries); A.C. simt badalta (generators, mains).
Conventional current: musbat charge ka mutabadil bahao, zyada se kam potential (source ke bahar + se -), electron ke bahao ke ulat.
